newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Kimberly Clark buys Czech diaper maker.
newsitem.headline: Kimberly Clark buys Czech diaper maker.

text.p: Kimberly Clark Corp said Thursday it purchased the largest Czech diaper maker, Zisoft-Bobi a.s., for an undisclosed sum, pending local regulatory approval.
"The transaction, which must still be approved by the Ministry for Economic Competition, was executed on Oct. 1, 1996," Kimberly Clark said in a statement.
"Thanks to (the acquisition) Kimberly Clark has become the largest company in the field of personal care in the Czech Republic."
It said the purchase price would not be made public.
